title: ship-sop configuration
description: Per-project configuration for ship-sop auto-mode and per-agent toggles.

mode.description: auto = SessionStop hook fires the pipeline; manual = /ship only; off = pipeline disabled entirely

min_diff_lines.description: Skip auto-fire if diff is smaller than this many lines

skip_docs_only.description: Skip auto-fire entirely when only .md / docs/ files changed (doc-builder otherwise still runs to keep generated docs in sync)

cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive auto-fires on the same diff state

skip_branch_patterns.description: Regex patterns; auto-fire skips branches matching any of these

agents.description: Per-agent toggles. Keys are agent names; values control whether the gate runs and what severity blocks ship.

enabled.description: If false, the gate is skipped

block_on.description: Severity that hard-blocks ship. 'never' makes the gate advisory.

auto_file_backlog.description: Whether the agent should auto-file findings as Backlog entries

auto_publish.description: If true, /release publishes without confirmation prompt. Strongly discouraged.

default_branch.description: Branch from which releases are cut

version_source.description: File to read the current version from. Supports package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, version.txt

artifacts.description: Optional housekeeping for files written under docs/reviews/.

retain_ship_artifact_days.description: If > 0, prune ship-sop gate artifacts (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-*.md) older than this many days at hook fire time. Agent-sop /update-sop reviews (YYYY-MM-DD_<agent-id>_P<n>.md) are never touched. Default 0 disables retention.
